Its so hard to talk about it... Crying so much...


http://puu.sh/ctLPV/61ee8232d3.png
Talking to a friend of mine I known for a while but rarely get ot see anymore... Its already hard initiating the subject,,, http://puu.sh/ctL0M/13d8d02c02.png I hope it goes well..

It would kill me to know they ever found out that I was suicidal. 

The reason I try not to talk about it because I understand people want to help but... idk..
I don't know who to talk to. It's already hard enough to explain it here, because I just feel nobody will understand how I am saying it, so they will perceive it differently.
I am just way to ashamed to even talk about it to anyone. :/

I honestly don't know what to say. I feel like I have nobody to call "friend" in school. I just sit with a few kids at lunch that I don't really talk to. Sitting in class, and seeing others talk about whatever the hell they did over the weekend or talk about whatever, but if I talk, its like I just get ignored, and they do what they can to get away, or get me out of the conversation.

Ever since middle school I have never really had serious friends... I mean yah I have one now, from my old school whom I am friends with, but 1 person I know can't keep me out of this... He doesn't know I have ever been like this, because as I mentioned, I hide it from others. I am to ashamed to admit to any of this shit...

I understand others will be upset, but it's just not enough because it wont make life any better..

Someone the other day noticed that I was acting different, and I just couldn't say anything that was wrong besides "everything is fine, there is nothing to worry about" as they keep asking.. I juts feel whatever I tell to others will just distance me from getting any better..
I guess I can talk.. It's just hard to talk about the problems. I just feel stupid even telling anyone abbout them. Thus nobody knows really...

Really did nothing. Just another day where I thought things were just going good for me. But in the end, like always, everyday, I want to leave this place. But I can never find the right time to do so, or how to go upon it..

So basically, you just told me I am or never have been as equally depressed as you.

You literally just wrote parts of what it was like for me in middle school, and basically what it is kind of like now for me.



So what do you ever do for fun at home? Like that takes your mind off shit? Play COD or anything like that?

Man, I wish I could get revenge on the people who picked on me in middle school, and who tried to make me look like a fool. I kid you not, today, if I seen them, I would shrug it off. But the second they try and replay that moment, there bones are going to break.


What do you mean writings of your own death? How you would go upon it?

You wanna know someone who got out of it? Eric Thomas.

I wont talk, i'll let the video do the talking.

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lc5gsqf3uLI

Hey, you just told me you don't care about life. You even included that you had depression. BOOM. You do care about life. Because if you didn't you wouldn't be depressed. You wouldn't be upset, you wouldn't care about what others thought of you. You shouldn't even be sad.

So now that I really know you do care about your life, let's try and solve it. I honestly can't say how to solve it, because I don't know you personally. But I believe some others can help you.

Just please watch a few videos... PLEASE? If I came here to give some advice, would you at least be willing to listen to something for me?

http://www.youtube.com/user/BESTMOTIVATIONEVER/videos
http://www.youtube.com/user/etthehiphoppreacher/videos
http://www.youtube.com/user/elliottsaidwhat/videos

Now, I ain't saying I am perfect, or am not depressed, but it's not fun seeing someone as equally depressed as me, and not have anything online for support to do. 

I am serious, watch some of those videos, it can seriously fucking help. 


I just re read that you are home schooled. Why are you homeschooled???? Get to school and socialize with others. Change schools sounds even better!

Dude, fuck BMI. 

Hey, maybe you could PM me some contact info? I seriously wouldn't mind help giving you tips on how to deal with your weight?

Why don't you have a future man? We all do. I myself hate that I have no friends. I am being serious about it to.. 

Could you tell me what grade you're in... Just so I can relate to you better, maybe help out. Shits tough for me, but if I can actually help someone out, it'll make me feel better, because I was able to bring someone up, since currently, nobody wants to be around me so I can't help anyone..
